steps.title: On the road

lines.text: Where you come from, you sell your hours to pay for land, homes and tools that others own.
And every year, machines need fewer of those hours.
So you set out to find another way to live.
With a backpack, a bottle of water and a seed from home.

steps.title: Imagine

lines.text: Imagine a whole city that grows its own food, makes its own power and builds its own homes.
There is a vision of it: a blueprint for a new generation of cities. It's why you got on this van.

steps.title: A HEART every hour

lines.text: “There, every hour of your life brings you a HEART. Not for your work. For your life.”
“A HEART is not money. It is your right to become an owner, and only people get it.”

lines.text: The old world passed this place by.
Here, the old road ends.
And something new begins.
Welcome to MaiaCity. You are among our very first human founders.

lines.text: Today, its city centre is just a gas station. In 16 years, a thriving solarpunk city stands here, feeding 1 million co-founders.

steps.title: Co-owner of MaiaCity

lines.text: Samuel and Daniel come to fetch you together.
And from the first day, you can own a part of it.
MaiaCOOP holds the land. Village COOP owns our homes and shared equipment.
Its land is never sold, so no one can ever buy it away from you.
Every HEART you invest becomes a MIND: your share of MaiaCity.
